summary.discovery_method: PyPI latest-version check plus GitHub issue search/review via gh search issues and gh api graphql

cases.title: f2py.crackfortran mutates global re._MAXCACHE at import time
cases.confirmation_signal: WarrenWeckesser called the line bad practice, opened PR #31105, and explicitly noted that 2.4.4 had already shipped the day before.
cases.local_detail: re._MAXCACHE changed from 512 to 50 after importing numpy.f2py.crackfortran.
cases.input_summary: Import the f2py crackfortran module after reading the process-wide regex cache size.
cases.hypothesis_sketch: st.just('import re, numpy.f2py.crackfortran as cf') with an oracle over re._MAXCACHE before/after import

cases.title: vecdot of object arrays along zero-length slice is None
cases.confirmation_signal: Issue was closed by merged PR #31033: 'BUG: Fix np.vecdot on empty object vectors returning None'.
cases.local_detail: np.vecdot(np.array([], dtype=object), np.array([], dtype=object)) returned None.
cases.input_summary: Call np.vecdot on empty object-dtype arrays.
cases.hypothesis_sketch: st.just(np.array([], dtype=object)) and compare vecdot against an additive identity expectation rather than None

cases.title: np.fft.hfft / ifft2 / irfft2 ignore the out parameter
cases.confirmation_signal: WarrenWeckesser replied that three FFT functions had the problem and pointed to the exact out=None call sites.
cases.local_detail: For hfft, return value was not the provided output array and the provided out buffer stayed all zeros.
cases.input_summary: Pass a writable output array to affected FFT functions and check whether it is honored.

cases.title: busdaycalendar weekmask rejects a boolean NumPy array
cases.confirmation_signal: WarrenWeckesser explicitly thanked the reporter for the bug, identified the failing conversion path, and documented the workaround.
cases.local_detail: np.busdaycalendar accepted a boolean NumPy array weekmask on local 2.4.4.
cases.input_summary: Construct a busdaycalendar with weekmask=np.array([...], dtype=bool).
cases.hypothesis_sketch: st.just(np.array([True, True, True, True, True, False, False]))

cases.title: meshgrid return type depends on the value of copy
cases.confirmation_signal: ngoldbaum and seberg agreed the implementation should be fixed to match the documented tuple return type.
cases.local_detail: np.meshgrid(..., copy=True) and np.meshgrid(..., copy=False) both returned tuple on local 2.4.4.
cases.input_summary: Call np.meshgrid with copy=True and copy=False and compare the return container type.
